```{r}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)

df <- read.csv(here("p301.csv"))

df_wy<- df |> group_by(wy) |> 
  summarise(total_streamflow = sum(streamflow), total_precip = sum(precip), percent_streamflow = (total_streamflow/total_precip)*100)

 mean(df_wy$percent_streamflow)

 range(df_wy$percent_streamflow)
 
 sd(df_wy$percent_streamflow)



```
